world.title: US senators urge Trump administration to act against 3 India-based cyber firms over data theft allegations
world.summary: A bipartisan group of US senators has called on the Trump administration to take action against three India-based cyber firms accused of hacking campaigns. These firms are alleged to have targeted American individuals, businesses, and over 1,000 lawyers. The senators emphasize the need for a response to protect national security and safeguard sensitive information from foreign cyber threats.

world.title: Pakistan blinks on Houthis, walks back Saudi defence warning within 24 hours
world.summary: Pakistan has retracted its previous warning to the Houthis regarding military responses linked to the Mecca defense pact. The clarification, issued by Islamabad, states that there are no ongoing discussions about military action. This shift comes just a day after strong statements from Pakistan's defense minister, indicating a change in the country's stance on the matter.

world.title: Australia’s plan to let users opt out of social media algorithms | Explained
world.summary: Australia is implementing a plan to allow social media users to opt out of algorithm-driven feeds, aiming to enhance online safety. This initiative is part of a broader effort to provide users with greater control over their social media experience. The move reflects the country's commitment to improving online safety norms and addressing concerns related to algorithmic content delivery.

business.title: Here Are Thursday’s Top Wall Street Analyst Research Calls: Advanced Micro Devices, Amgen, AngloGold Ashanti, Caterpillar, Chewy, Meta Platforms, Novartis, NVIDIA, SK hynix, and More
business.summary: Wall Street analysts are adjusting their positions in semiconductors, biotech, and energy as markets decline amid rising crude oil prices above $100 and multi-year high Treasury yields. Pre-market stock futures are lower following two consecutive days of losses for major indices. Investors await an inflation report that could influence the Federal Reserve's next policy decision.

business.title: India launches tap-and-pay option for real-time payments ahead of full Apple Pay rollout
business.summary: India's payments authority introduced a tap-and-pay option in its real-time payments network on September 10, facilitating quicker transactions. This move comes ahead of the anticipated full rollout of Apple Pay in the country. The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) aims to enhance digital payment accessibility and efficiency, reflecting India's ongoing efforts to modernize its financial infrastructure.

business.title: NATS Given Week to Investigate Flight Halts, ETTravelWorld
business.summary: Britain's NATS, the air traffic control authority, has one week to investigate a significant system failure that caused widespread flight cancellations and stranded passengers. The transport minister confirmed the issue was not due to cyberattacks. The incident has financial implications for airlines, and discussions about potential compensation for affected travelers have raised questions regarding NATS chief executive Martin Rolfe's position.

technology.title: YouTuber claims LG TVs spy on users even when turned off
technology.summary: A YouTube investigation by Gamers Nexus alleges that LG TVs eavesdrop on users even when powered off. The video claims that these smart televisions continuously log user data and transmit it back to LG. This revelation raises concerns about privacy and data security for consumers using LG products, prompting discussions about the implications of smart technology in everyday life.

technology.title: Samsung brings Galaxy S26 Ultra and Galaxy S26 to Certified Re-Newed programme; devices available at up to 85% of launch price
technology.summary: Samsung has included the Galaxy S26 Ultra and Galaxy S26 in its Certified Re-Newed programme in India. These smartphones are now available at discounts of up to 85% off their original launch prices. The renewed devices are sold through Samsung's official channels, ensuring quality and reliability for consumers seeking more affordable options for these models.

technology.title: Motorola teases mysterious wide foldable phone as potential iPhone Duo rival
technology.summary: Motorola has teased a new wide foldable phone, potentially rivaling Apple's iPhone Duo. This announcement follows the recent launch of the Razr Fold in early 2026. In an official video, the unreleased device was briefly showcased, indicating a horizontal book-style design. The new phone aims to expand Motorola's foldable portfolio, enhancing competition in the market.

sports.title: East Zone keep South at bay to clinch Duleep Trophy
sports.summary: East Zone won the Duleep Trophy 2026 by maintaining a substantial first-innings lead over South Zone. After securing a 372-run advantage, East Zone extended their second innings until the end of the match. Ishan Kishan led the team, and by the end of the fourth day, they were positioned at 212/5, holding a commanding 584-run lead.

sports.title: Mohammad Rizwan, Imam-ul-Haq face cyber crime probe over alleged Pakistan team leaks; third cricketer involved: Report
sports.summary: The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has initiated a cyber crime investigation involving cricketers Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq over alleged leaks from the national team. The PCB has confiscated the players' mobile phones and submitted them to relevant authorities. Reports indicate that both players received notices regarding the investigation on Monday, with a third cricketer also implicated.

sports.title: Mohammed Shami reveals desire to reach next level in his career
sports.summary: Veteran Indian pacer Mohammed Shami expresses his desire to elevate his career despite not playing for India since March 2025. He reflects on East Zone's Duleep Trophy victory, marking his 100th first-class match. Shami shares insights on domestic cricket, mentoring young players, and his strategic approach to bowling in challenging conditions, emphasizing his ongoing motivation and commitment.

health.title: The Impact of Rapid Next-Generation Sequencing on Precision Oncology, ETHealthworld
health.summary: Rapid next-generation sequencing (NGS) is significantly impacting precision oncology by facilitating timely treatment decisions through detailed genomic profiling. This approach allows for cancer management to be informed by both the tumor's origin and the molecular changes driving its progression. As a result, NGS enhances personalized treatment strategies, improving patient outcomes in cancer care and management.

health.title: WHO SEA to improve access to medical devices, IVD
health.summary: The WHO South-East Asia Region has pledged to enhance equitable access to quality-assured and affordable medical devices, including in vitro diagnostics (IVDs) and assistive technologies. This initiative will adopt an integrated life-cycle approach, covering planning, regulation, procurement, maintenance, replacement, and safe decommissioning. For the first time, Member States discussed medical devices at a WHO Regional Committee meeting.

health.title: Robot-Assisted Stroke Rehabilitation Improves Recovery
health.summary: A randomised controlled trial found that robot-assisted stroke rehabilitation significantly enhanced upper limb motor recovery in patients with chronic stroke compared to conventional cognitive rehabilitation. This single-centre exploratory study highlights the potential benefits of integrating robotic technology into rehabilitation practices, suggesting improved outcomes for stroke survivors. Further research may be needed to confirm these findings and explore broader applications.

science.title: Have scientists finally detected dark matter? - video
science.summary: Scientists may be closer to detecting dark matter, which constitutes 85% of the universe's matter but remains invisible. The findings could significantly alter our understanding of the cosmos. Ian Sample discusses the implications with Madeleine Finlay, while Dr. Samuel Erikson from the University of Bristol shares insights on the research's reception within the physics community.

science.title: Fast radio bursts may help study dark matter
science.summary: US researchers analyzed approximately 100 fast radio bursts (FRBs) to measure the impact of galactic feedback on matter inhomogeneity in intergalactic space. This study marks the first direct measurement using FRBs, potentially advancing the understanding of dark matter and cosmic structures. The findings may provide valuable insights into the behavior of matter in the universe.

science.title: From Mercury to Neptune: NASA's stunning images of all 8 Planets in our Solar System
science.summary: NASA has released stunning images of all eight planets in our solar system, showcasing their unique features. From Mercury's cratered landscape to Neptune's vibrant blue atmosphere, these visuals highlight the diversity and beauty of each planet. The images were obtained through decades of robotic space missions, providing humanity with unprecedented views of our celestial neighbors.

entertainment.title: Samantha Ruth Prabhu calls her pregnancy a ‘surprise’, says she and Raj Nidimoru were ‘okay’ not having kids
entertainment.summary: Samantha Ruth Prabhu announced her pregnancy with Raj Nidimoru, describing it as a "surprise." The couple, who made their relationship official in December last year, had previously been content with the idea of not having children. Prabhu's comments reflect a shift in their plans as they prepare for their first child together.

entertainment.title: 'Yeh Nagma hai?': Netizens are shocked to see Shah Rukh Khan, Sanjay Dutt, Akshay Kumar, Ravi Kishan's co-star making a rare appearance looking unrecognisable
entertainment.summary: Nagma, a prominent figure in 90s Hindi cinema, made a rare public appearance at a press conference hosted by the Cine And TV Artistes Association (CINTAA) on Wednesday. Attendees expressed surprise at her changed appearance, as she has largely remained out of the public eye in recent years. Nagma's presence sparked discussions among netizens regarding her transformation.

entertainment.title: Can you guess all 3 OG Indian beauty queens at Abu Jani Sandeep Khosla's show? One is a Miss Universe 1992 runner-up
entertainment.summary: Madhu Sapre, the Miss Universe 1992 runner-up, reunited with two iconic figures from the early 90s at Abu Jani Sandeep Khosla's store launch. The event celebrated the legacy of Indian beauty queens, highlighting their influence on glamour in the country. The gathering evoked nostalgia for those familiar with the era of Doordarshan and Femina magazine.
